name: spinner
title: Spinner
summary: Indeterminate loader. Lucide Loader2 + animate-spin at 0.9s. Honors prefers-reduced-motion (slows the rotation). role=status + aria-label='Loading' for screen readers.
description: Indeterminate loader; lucide Loader2 + slower spin (0.9s) for premium feel.
skillDescription: Use for indeterminate async loads — button loading state, inline 'Fetching rates', skeleton replacement. Composed inside Button via `loading` prop; use standalone for inline indicators. role=status + aria-label='Loading'.
useWhen: Async button loading (composed via Button loading prop).
Standalone async data loads (when Skeleton isn't appropriate).
never: NEVER use Spinner for determinate loads (use Progress).
do: Set size to match context (16 inline, 24 standalone, 32 hero).
